qualification_rows.criterion: Non-replicated 16-bit samples: endian interpretation, low-byte contribution, conversion thresholds and profile/alpha precision against the pinned reference. The 8-bit-lattice cells do not establish this.
qualification_rows.spec_anchor: PNG selects the pinned default frame

qualification_rows.criterion: Independent nontrivial color/alpha rounding vectors, PNG compositing and PDF straight samples; all-zero and partial alpha boundaries.
16-bit grayscale/RGB tRNS comparison before reduction: samples sharing high bytes but differing low bytes, exact matches and out-of-range keys.
qualification_rows.spec_anchor: Source bytes, profiles, metadata, animation, and source alpha

qualification_rows.criterion: Optional PLTE on RGB/RGBA does not change samples; indexed palettes at maximum and minimum sizes and unused entries preserve source bytes.
qualification_rows.spec_anchor: Direct SVG embeds validated compressed raster payload octets exactly.

qualification_rows.criterion: sRGB rendering intents 0,1,2,3, invalid intent bytes, missing/duplicate chunks, grayscale and RGB interpretation.
gAMA 100000 selects linear-sRGB conversion; independently authored ramp, endpoints, RGB and grayscale, 8/16-bit inputs.
gAMA 45455 and other positive values, zero/invalid metadata, transfer conversion boundaries for RGB and grayscale.
sRGB and non-sRGB cHRM primaries/white points with absent and explicit gAMA; degenerate/out-of-range chromaticities and reference recovery.
ICC v2 RGB matrix/TRC profiles, independent transformed vectors, profile parsing and channel/model consistency.
ICC v4 RGB matrix/parametric-TRC profiles, independent transformed vectors and unsupported parameter recovery.
ICC v2/v4 grayscale profiles: characterize admission and actual transform compatibility of expanded grayscale samples; do not infer support from profile parsing.
ICC RGB LUT and multi-process profiles, intent/table selection, accepted transform classes and explicit unsupported-class recovery.
CMYK/Lab/device-link and incompatible ICC model signatures: exact SVG preservation versus PNG/PDF interpretation/recovery.
Malformed iCCP names, compression methods/streams, truncated profiles and duplicate metadata; exact typed failures or specified metadata-ignore behavior.
cICP, iCCP, sRGB and gAMA/cHRM precedence, conflicting and malformed higher-priority signals, legal chunk positions and duplicate chunks.
Reserved/unspecified primaries and transfers, non-identity/unknown matrices and range values 2..255; exact format-specific preservation or rejection.
gmAP/gdAT base selection and declared SDR projection against canonical reference vectors; ancillary chunk acceptance alone is not evidence of gain-map interpretation.
Absent, partial, malformed, duplicate or invalid gain-map metadata/payloads, including bounded nested data and their exact recovery.
Gain maps combined with cICP PQ/HLG, ICC and legacy signals: reference-selected base/transfer, precedence and tone-mapping vectors.
Absent, invalid, truncated and unsupported TIFF/eXIf tags; duplicate eXIf chunks and precise rejection versus ignored-metadata behavior.
One-frame acTL with included or separate default image: select animation frame zero, preserve SVG bytes, and remain diagnostically silent.
Animation frame-zero rectangles and offsets on transparent canvas, both default layouts, alpha and exact output dimensions.
qualification_rows.spec_anchor: PNG selects the pinned default frame

qualification_rows.criterion: Source/over blend crossed with none/background/previous disposal, first-frame special cases and later frames; validate every accepted control and preserve SVG animation.
qualification_rows.spec_anchor: each actually rendered multi-frame asset occurrence

qualification_rows.criterion: acTL/fcTL/fdAT order, sequence counters, declared frame counts, missing/extra controls and data; malformed later frames must block SVG passthrough too.
Corrupt later animation streams with valid CRCs, split fdAT runs and mismatched frame dimensions; complete validation precedes any successful artifact.
Every forbidden color-type/depth, zero dimensions, invalid compression/filter/interlace method and misplaced/duplicate IHDR.
CRC, truncated/overflowing lengths, chunk-type/reserved bits, unknown critical versus ancillary chunks, missing/duplicate IEND and trailing bytes.
Palette requirements, forbidden/empty/oversized PLTE, out-of-range indexes, duplicate/misordered/malformed tRNS and invalid alpha-model combinations.
Zlib/Adler corruption behind valid chunk CRC, invalid row filters, short/long rows, Adam7 pass extents and nonconsecutive/missing IDAT data.
Byte/dimension/pixel/work equality and first crossing for packed, 16-bit and interlaced PNG and both APNG layouts; direct SVG validates without deriving output pixels.
PNG/PDF decode and projection work, shared identities versus occurrences, profile workspace, masks and bounded recovery artifacts.
Establish sample-layout/color/orientation/animation composition with explicit crossing vectors or reviewed equivalence arguments; independent axis evidence alone is not exhaustive profile coverage.
